t: goal
Learn what happened to the lizardman eggs that have been stolen by the draconids.
startText

It ssseems that draconids only want one thing from usss lizardmen and that's our eggsss. We don't know why, and they don't ssseem likely to tell us - they're not exactly the sssharing kind.
Please go to the Cursed Lands - that'sss where they're taking our eggsss. Try to find out what they're doing with them! No matter how terrible the truth may be, we mussst know!
checkText
A baby draconid has just emerged from the egg...
finishText
This explains it! The draconids are bewitching the stolen eggs with their spells. As a result, draconids emerge from the eggs instead of lizardmen!
goal
Meet with Horn the Roughneck on Darkscale Isle.
startText

Here's a new order from Nestor:
"Horn the Roughneck has landed on Darkscale Isle. You'll be able to find him along the south eastern coast. Go to him, I'm sure the two of you will have lots to talk about!"
Thanks for the letter, raven.
finishText

So Golovanov thinks you can help us? Sure, go right ahead. These isles are such a mess that you'll need a great, big bottle of Nezebovka just to make sense out of anything!
Lizardmen, draconids... Who do you fight, who do you ally with? I'm no politician, but I trust these aborigines as far as I can throw 'em!
text
Fly, little bird! Come back quickly!
goal
Meet with Marta Kopeva in the Cursed Lands.
startText

The draconids are definitely using their magic to turn the unborn lizardmen into baby draconids... The lizardmen won't be able to handle this sort of threat alone. The longer these violations go unhindered, the fewer lizardmen and the more draconids there will be.
You remember Kromus mentioning the Demon Hunters. He wanted to ask them for help. Perhaps you should find the nearest Demon Hunter and inquire about an alliance.
finishText

Hush, you'll give away my position... I'm a Demon Hunter working under Horn the Roughneck. He sent me to investigate this part of the allod when we landed. You seem totally out of place... Who are you and what are you doing here?
goal
Kill 6 Draconid Lookouts for Marta Kopeva.
startText

This is perfect! Horn the Roughneck had some of us watching the lizardmen. He wanted to find some way to enter an alliance with them. You say that you've managed to make friends with them?
Excellent! That means that half the battle is already done! I will go to this Vergon and tell him everything that you've learned about the eggs and the draconids' magic.
Unfortunately, I'm afraid that I won't be able to make it past these draconid guards alone. Go and clear a path for me, okay? Then I can begin negotiating with these lizardmen.
checkText
I wonder if the draconids able to reproduce on their own, or if they absolutely need the lizardmen's eggs?
finishText
Great, now I'll have no problem getting to Vergon. You helped me, so now I'll help you! Vergon will receive your message, Demon Hunter's honor!
goal
Kill 6 Hungering Predators on Darkscale Isle without engaging Draconids in combat. Report back to Horn the Roughneck.
startText

Alright, let's do it.
Golovanov really wants to make friends with the Draconids. Those hideous things! I'd never trust them. But orders are orders. Now listen.
Demons are fighting the Draconids near the Astral Fangs. The enemy of our enemy is our friend, right? If you go over there and kill at least six demons, the Draconids might change their mind and ally with us! Eh? What do you think?
But whatever you do, don't hurt the Draconids! We need to show them we are friends. Got it?
checkText
Are all the demons dead? We need to show those draconids that we'd make great allies!
finishText

It seems as if your feats haven't impress the draconids... not one bit. They're probably thinking that they can make do without any allies and that we're nothing but a pesky obstacle in their way. That's a real shame!
goal
Find a traitor amongst the cultists that's willing to leak information and report back to Horn the Roughneck.
startText

I chopped that Gorluxor scum's head off myself and then cut him up into tiny pieces. I held his head in my very hands!
I don't know who it was that you killed, but my Gorluxor was real! Do you think maybe he had a twin brother? Or maybe a clone?! Those cultists probably know something...
Those boys aren't exactly social, but I'm willing to bet that you'll find a few cowards among them. It's up to you to find one and shake the truth out of him! Those cultists are always hanging around the Cursed Lands, that's just south of here. Go and press a few of 'em, see if one cracks!
checkText

Did you capture and crack any cultists yet?
Scoundrels like that must have at least one coward in their midst!
finishText
So the allod is held up by the Great Dragon and the draconids are his servants. That explains why they didn't want to talk to us. They wouldn't dare move a muscle without their master's say-so.
goal
Collect 6 portions of Muskir Slime for Semer Hor.
startText

This might be a great place for an alchemist!
Vadim Shishkin brought me the Draconid weapons that you salvaged from the battlefield. I analyzed the mixture that they're coated with but couldn't identify most of the components. Me! The one who knows more about potions, decoctions, and elixirs than anyone else!
But I've learned something after all. One of the ingredients is definitely muskir slime. You can find them in the jungle. Bring me six portions of their slime, I wish to study it thoroughly.
checkText
I've only got basic lab equipment with me which, unfortunately, is not enough for a complete analysis of this poison. Where's the slime I asked for?
finishText

Thanks, now let me get to work...
It looks as if it contains some sort of poison! The poison itself is relatively mild, too mild to take down a demon, but when mixed with other ingredients it becomes absolutely lethal. I will keep these samples for later, they may come in handy...
goal
Bring a Draconid Staff to Viktor Tairov.
startText

Those draconids are crafty little devils. Our scouts report that they've found a way to destroy Astral fangs!
Supposedly, the fangs wither and die after a ritual performed by a draconid augur. But the most surprising part of this story is that it seems to be the augur's staff that's doing all the work!
There's a cluster of Astral fangs just to the south of here, go and see if you can't wrestle a staff from one of the augurs.
checkText
I grant remission of sin of assassination for the one who will bring me the staff. In the name of Light!
finishText

I'll study this staff at once! Both the League and the Empire have expended tons of time, resources, and efforts into finding a way to destroy the Astral fangs, but nothing has worked so far... Perhaps we'll finally be able to solve this secret and deal with the fang problem once and for all!
goal
Obtain the head of Great Mage Gorluxor and take it to Nestor Golovanov on Dusky Isle.
startText

Gorluxor is alive? That's utter hogwash! I was face to face with that ugly mug – there's no way I could have been wrong!
How do I know? Because I saw a giant poster on Kirah that said - "Wanted - Great Mage Gorluxor." I'll remember that poster until the day I die! So there couldn't have been any mistake! That is, unless he grew himself a replacement head and rose back from the dead that way!
There's only one way to get to the bottom of this. Go and get the head of this new Gorluxor guy! And when you do, bring it to Golovanov - let him deal with it!
checkText
I can't stop thinking about Gorluxor and his two heads! Our reputation could take a real hit if we don't find out what really happened!
finishText

So, Gorluxor thought that he tricked everyone, huh?! I'm sure he counted on us believing him to be dead and leaving his cultists alone while he continued merrily destroying allods, one by one. But now that we've finally put an end to his shenanigans, let's hope he stays dead this time! Thank you for this - you've done truly heroic work. I shall see to it that from here on out your name shall be recorded on the Board of Honor over at Kirah, alongside the greatest Demon Hunters to ever prowl the Astral!
goal
Take Gorluxor's head to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.
startText

Gorluxor's flair for the dramatic has turned out to be the end of him. More than anything, he wanted to kill the dragon alone - a deadly miscalculation! You could say that the devious old fox got exactly what was coming to him!
Take his head to Crazystorm the Merciless and report on all that has happened here. Now no one will dare accuse the hunters of fraud - our reputation is saved!
checkText
Another Gorluxor head? That's the third one! We've just about got a complete set! Would you like me to organize an exhibit?
finishText

Let's hope that's the last we hear of Gorluxor...
If some other hero shows up with another head of his, I'm going to lose it!
Though, this one actually looks legit. That must mean that the cultists are in disarray, totally lost without their leader. We'll join up with the hunters and catch all those bastards! Then we'll either kill them or send 'em off to work the meteorite ore mines! Perhaps a bit of honest work for the glory of the Empire will tighten up the screws in those loony heads of theirs!
goal
Take Gorluxor's Head to the Defender Captain, Izbor Yavorsky, in Novograd.
startText

Gorluxor's head. His real one this time! Can you believe that this rogue thought he could trick us?! Now look where his tricks got him!
Take his foolish dome to Izbor Yavorsky and tell him about all that has happened. Surely, this will dismiss any charges and no one will dare accuse the hunters of premeditated fraud!
checkText

Another head! My own head is about to spin off my neck over this damned Gorluxor!
But you say this one is genuine?
finishText

Gorluxor tried to trick us, but it didn't work. Now that he's really dead, the cultists have lost their leadership. I reckon they won't be nearly as dangerous from here on.
Together with the hunters, we'll catch them all soon enough.
goal
Speak with Soliskar the Wise on Drakefang Isle.
startText

If that cultist coward is speaking the truth, then Gorluxor is on his way here to kill the Great Dragon! We need to intercept and speak with him! He has the power to will the draconids to aid us against Gorluxor.
Go to him and try to make a good impression! We can't mess this up!
finishText
Who dares to disturb the rest of the Great Dragon? What do you want from her?! Mortals do not deserve to even look at the Great Dragon, let alone speak with them! I will be her Voice for you.
goal
Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Cultists and return to Nestor Golovanov in the Hunters' Camp.
startText

Look at Drakefang Isle! Yuck! Fangs all over the place! It won't last long. They'll take it apart. Unless we do something about it.
It's not just the Hunters' duty to take out demons and cultists. It concerns everyone who wants to survive in our world. And I think the Draconids share my view. And dragons. And the Great Dragon, of course.
So this is what we'll do. We must help our future allies in the fight against the demonic horde! If we don't stop them, they'll get to the Great Dragon, and I'm not sure she'll be able to defend herself!
We must take them out. Kill six Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Cultists. Report back to Nestor Golovanov.
checkText
Horn the Roughneck has sent word of the demons' and cultists' attack on Drakefang Isle! Let's hope our friends managed to repel the enemy!
finishText

Looks like Horn the Roughneck was correct - the enemy's real target was the dragon! And if it weren't for your swift counterattack, they would've fought their way through to him to try and wear him out for Gorluxor's arrival!
Perhaps that was his plan all along. Either way, our enemies have been defeated. I thank you for your timely assistance - a whole squad of warriors couldn't do a finer job!
goal
Help Soliskar the Wise to defeat Gorluxor by killing demons he summons.
startText

Mortals! You failed this world! We brought it to the brink of destruction!
Oh, we remember everything! Everything! Centuries of murders, wars, crimes... You are driven only by lust for power, greed, and malice. The Junes started hunting the Dragons, and your vaunted Grand Mages have joined in! And now, when Sarnaut is in peril, you continue to fight and kill each other instead of joining forces...
What?! Who dares to interrupt the mistress?
Aah! Gorluxor, the leader of the Cult of Destruction!
You say you can be trusted?
Well, prove it! Help her deal with Gorluxor! Attack his minions!
checkText
Your actions will speak louder than your words, you know!
finishText

Argh!
Well, thank you! Your help was welcome!
You seem to be trustworthy... I never thought I'd say that to a scaleless one...
Okay! I want to reward you! Choose what you like.
Afterwards, we will continue the conversation. The mistress will speak directly through me.
goal
Send a Courier Raven with a letter inquiring about the Great Mages.
startText

The voice that comes from the seneschal's mouth is more powerful than before.
Your bravery impressed me... You say you represent some kind of Demon Hunters?
Hmm... Hmm... So they do that? Exterminate astral creatures and cultists? And they want to propose an alliance?
Do you have a way to contact them? Before I make a decision, I need to get an answer to a very important question.
Are there any Great Mages among the Demon Hunters? If so, then an alliance is out of the question, argh!
Raven? Send it quickly. I'll wait for an answer...
In the meantime, you can do one more important task for me. Once you're done, you should try summoning a raven.
checkText
Did you get the letter? What does it say? I need to know who I'm allying myself with and who's really backing the hunters!
finishText
The hunters don't have any Great Mages! That's probably for the best. Those Great Mages often tend to suffer from delusions of grandeur and those things never end well for anybody!
goal
Use the Firestone on 6 Savage Dragons and report back to Soliskar the Wise.
startText

Once again, Soliskar's voice comes from the seneschal's mouth.
While the raven carries the letter, I will ask you for one more favor.
What do you see in the Astral? The Octulhu! A terrible astral creature that is a threat even to me. My faithful servants - the drakes - are going to attack it again. But you need to give them the Firestones before the fight. With their help, the drakes will do it faster.
I will cast the Friend of Dragons spell on you so that the drakes will not attack you. Go and give them 6 stones.
checkText
Please, take these firestones to my little dragons. They're having a tough time out there as it is and if we don't help them, they won't stand a chance against the octulhu!
finishText

Thank you for your help! My dragons are just little creatures, but what they lack in size they make up for with valor and loyalty! Just watch them spin joyous somersaults in the air when this filthy beasts finally croaks! Try your raven again - it should be close by now!
goal
Relay Soliskar's decision to Nestor Golovanov.
startText

Sirkey's eyes light up with a flame that seems older than the stones of this allod.
"I have made my final decision!
I will make a pact with the Demon Hunters. But only with them! The Hunters can be trusted. For two reasons.
First, there are no Great Mages among them. The second one is you.
You managed to impress me! I hope our paths cross again some day...
Let this Nestor Golovanov know my decision.
Now go. I have things to do!"
finishText

With an ally like that we will wipe all the enemies off this allod! It's good we didn't start warring with the draconids! Had we done so, I bet it would've been much harder to get on the dragon's good side!
text

Oh, even I can manage this much!
Go!
goal
Wait for the Initiation Ritual to end.
startText

Oh, if only all my hunters were as brave and as adept as you! I hereby accept you into our ranks, to know you henceforth as a colleague and a brother in arms. Your name shall be recorded in the annals of the Demon Hunters' history. Yours is the example by which we shall raise our youth. Now, I'll conduct the initiation ritual. When it's done, you'll be a full-fledged member of our organization!
finishText

The ritual is complete! From here on out the hunters are your brothers in arms! We don't usually accept new members without a lengthy training period and exhausting trials... But you've already proven your bravery in action, so no further tests are required!
goal
Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep to speed up ship's construction.
startText
I know just how to thank you. If you are about to sail off to the Astral, and you've already started to build a ship, I can send a note to Nomarkh Hanotep to speed it up!
finishText
Beating Gorluxor himself is no joke at all! We need the likes of you in the Astral. I will discharge extra workers so that your ship would be constructed 10 days faster.
goal
Talk to the Glowy Family to speed up ship's construction.
startText
I know just how to thank you. If you are about to sail off to the Astral, and you've already started to build a ship, I can send a note to the Glowy Family to speed it up!
finishText
Beating Gorluxor himself is no joke at all! We need the likes of you in the Astral. We'll discharge extra builders so that your ship would be constructed 10 days faster.
goal
Collect 5 Rare Double Locks for Vlad Shuysky.
startText

Holy smokes! Look at this lock!
This just won't do. There's no way that they could stop a thief! Any one will break it open in no time! These youngsters just don't know what it's like to lose your goods in wartime! I've been already robbed two times this week!
You've got to bring me some proper locks. Please, your help could save lots of my wares. I'll be very much obliged!
checkText
What do you mean you can't find any? Did you try the Auction House?
finishText
Thank you! It's great there are such honest people like you!
goal
Bring 5 Rare Double Locks to Bulat the Rowdy in the Imperial Settlement.
startText

Do you know how to work a forge? Ah, never mind! Even if you don't you can still help out the Imperial Sentinels. I hate to say but while we are fighting, our stuff becomes an easy prey for dishonest pickers. We need to get some Rare Double Locks to secure our coffers.
Get the locks for us any way you can. Make them, buy them, barter for them - I don't care! Just get them to me one way or another. If you do, you can be sure the Imperial Sentinels won't forget it!
checkText
I personally detest locks. An Orc shouldn't hide anything! Unfortunately, thieves are poking into every corner, so I'll have to make an exception.
finishText

Good job!
I'll make sure the Sentinels know the locks are from you.
goal
Participate in killing Kuzurgar and bring his fang to Boom the Merciless.
startText

I see you're not from the Sentinels. That means you're allowed to risk your life for the sake of treasure and not just for your commander. Listen up because I have a job you might be interested in.
Soliskar is offering a reward for the fang of Kuzurgar, the leader of the black dragons. You see, we signed a peace treaty with Soliskar and the black dragons are traitors to all the other dragons. They have decided to serve the demons, and so they are our enemies as well.
If that's not enough of an incentive for you to help, you should know that Soliskar promises a reward for this job. I'd recommend that you gather some friends and take this Kuzurgar down.
checkText
There seem to be some members of every race that ally with the demons. Whether they're Elven or Xadaganian cultists, or these cursed dragons, no one seems immune to their influence.
finishText
Wow, this fang is pretty big. That must have been one tough fight. Here's your reward - take it with both Soliskar's and the Demon Hunters' blessing.
goal
Participate in killing Kuzurgar the Rebellious and take his Fang to Rogneda Boykova in the League Settlement.
startText

I have been sent a very odd message. I'm sure you know all about this, but recently the Demon Hunters on Dragon Ring were able to enter into a treaty with the Great Dragon and together they're fighting the remaining demons. That's pretty fantastic, right? But here's where it gets really interesting...
Soliskar, the leader of all dragons, has used the Demon Hunters to send us a message. She would like to ally with us in this fight against the demons, but we must first prove ourselves. There's a Great Dragon with a bounty on his head on this allod and this dragon and his clan have allied with the demons. Soliskar does not approve of this and has placed a bounty upon his head!
She says that if we bring her his fang, she'll side with us against the demons! We need that tooth! Go to the Blackened Shore and kill Kuzurgar the Rebellious!
checkText
It seems that dragons also have problems with allegiance with their kind.
finishText
Kuzurgar is dead? Wow, I'm sure Soliskar is going to be very pleased!
goal
Search under the fallen blocks for something valuable.
startText
These ancient stones look like they've been moved recently! It's as if they were carefully arranged to hide something... Perhaps there's some treasure underneath?
finishText
It looks like your guess was correct! There's a dusty chest located under the rubble. Those who keep their eyes open are always rewarded!
goal
Explore the old Xadaganian ruins to find the ancient treasure. Report back to Leon de Grandeur.
startText

What a day! I feel like helping everyone - even my enemies! I wonder why...?
Speaking of help...
There are many Xadaganian ruins on Yazes. There's also Gorluxor's Tower... I hear the Xadaganians were studying them before, back when this land was under Imperial control. I'm particularly interested in the ruins in the east of the Tainted Valley. I think I spotted a chest among the rocks last time I was in the area. Unfortunately I didn't have time to take a proper look. Perhaps you can do it! I just know there's treasure still out there.
checkText
When the war is over I hope we have time to come back to this allod and look through the ruins.
finishText
So I was right - there was something valuable out there! I wish I could put an end to these demons and do the most exciting thing in the world - search for ancient treasure!
goal
Find the 4 Stones of Yazes Shard and report back to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.
startText

To be able to call oneself a true scholar, one must be very aware of one's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with magic around Yazes Shard. Explore this desolate allod, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Tainted Valley, Blackened Shore, Wild Cape, and the Baneful Valley. Good luck, traveler.
checkText
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
finishText
You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
goal
Collect 5 Yazes Shard Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.
startText

Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler, but this is Yazes Shard!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill five of Yazes Shard's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Magmar, the darksoul ringleader, Varkuk the Dreadful, a savage Astral mauler, a savage Astral flayer or a darksoul exorcist will do just fine.
checkText
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?
finishText

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
goal
Kill 100 cultists and return to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.
startText

The fact that this allod is imperfect is as plain at the nose on your face. There are so many enemies here that telling you to go after one group probably wouldn't even make a dent! But that's what we're going to do anyway. So we should probably start out with those vile cultists.
Maybe if we take away the demons' fan club, they'll be easier to take down later. Go out there and kill as many as you can!
checkText
Those cultists tremble at the sound of your name now, right?
finishText

Thank you.
Hopefully now it will be easier for us to carry out our mission on Yazes Shard.
goal
Collect 7 pieces of Evelite and report back to anthropologist Sarang Nebmaatre.
startText

It doesn't look like there would be anything of value here, right? Well, you'd be wrong.
Yazes Shard is rich with a very rare mineral called Evelite! We're probably not the only ones that will be looking for Evelite, so the sooner that you can get out there and find some, the better!
Evelite can be found all throughout Yazes Shard hidden deep with the stone. Hurry, we must not let anyone else get their hands on the Evelite! Please hurry!
checkText
You can find the stones all over Yazes Shard. You just need to keep a sharp eye out!
finishText
Great! Now that we have it, we'll be able to create the most powerful weapons!
goal
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Sarang Nebmaatre.
startText

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Yazes Shard!
checkText
Have you completed all of my tasks?
finishText

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
goal
Find the 4 Stones of Yazes Shard and report back to anthropologist Germain de Blizare.
startText

To be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your surroundings.
As a test, I have placed four stones imbued with magic around Yazes Shard. Explore this desolate allod, find the stones and report back to me.

finishText

checkText
Stones with impregnated evelite you can find everywhere on the Shard.
finishText
You can find the stones all over Yazes Shard. You just need to keep a sharp eye out!
text

The only source of knowledge is experience! I can help you gain knowledge about this land through a series of educational tasks.
You can also help us Anthropologists with our own research! If you complete all of my assignments I promise that you'll be generously rewarded. I've heard recently some explorers were complaining that our tasks are too difficult. Well, why don't we find a solution beneficial to everyone?
I will sell you trophies and valuable resources required to complete two tasks. You can support our research in a way you like better.
goal
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Germain de Blizare.
startText

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Yazes Shard!
checkText
Have you completed all of my tasks?
finishText

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
goal
Go to the Isle of Gloom and kill 6 Magical Elementals. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

We had a great Astral storm here not too long ago. It was so big, that it blew a whole new small allod into Yazes Shard!
This would be a great place to for a new camp. Think about it, if we're on an island, they're going to have one hell of a time trying to get over to attack out camp! There's only one problem.
...It's full of elementals. We've tried just pushing them off, but those pesky things just float right back up! So we need you to go in and clear them out! Come on, it'll be no problem for you. Just get in there and do it.
checkText
The seizure of this new island is a strategically crucial task.
finishText

Great.
I knew you had it in you. We'll begin our move shortly.
goal
Go to the Isle of Gloom and kill 6 Magical Elementals. Report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

We had a great Astral storm here not too long ago. It was so big, that it blew a whole new small allod into Yazes Shard!
This would be a great place for us to mount a new attack! Why? Think about it, it's right next to their camp. They'll never expect us to pop up from the Astral! There's only one problem.
...It's full of elementals. We've tried just pushing them off, but those pesky things just float right back up! So we need you to go in and clear them out! Come on, it'll be no problem for you. Just get in there and do it.
checkText
The seizure of this new island is a strategically crucial task.
finishText

Great.
I knew you had it in you. We'll begin our move shortly.
goal
Kill 6 Vengeful Demon Mages or Malevolent Demon Mages and return to Evgeny Byvalin.
startText

Well done! People like you were worth their weight in meteorite during the Great Astral Campaign. It seems that almost all the rookies here are getting killed.
I hope you'll do better. Also...
I have considerable prestige among the Imperial Sentinels. I would be happy to put in a good word for you. If you continue to fight these demons, I'll make sure every commander knows your name.
Go out and kill a few demon mages and I'll see that your reputation among the Imperial Sentinels improves.
checkText
It's time to rid this allod of demons once and for all. No more hiding behind this barricade!
finishText
I'm glad I wasn't wrong about you. My colleagues are already discussing your heroics, you know. The praise is well-deserved!
goal
Collect 6 Astral Crystals by hunting Destroying Demons and bring them to Yaver Khaba in the Imperial Camp.
startText

Just as we require reagents to keep this portal closed, the cultists must require reagents to keep it open. If we were to destroy those items the portal would close forever. There's only one problem. We might eventually need to use the portal for our own purposes. If it closes we could lose a powerful tool.
If we take the cultists' reagents, then we could prevent them from strengthening the portal. That would make our job much easier. We could also store them for later use so that we could suddenly open the portal when the time suited us.
I'm pretty sure the reagents the cultists use are imbued with Astral energy. Hunt them and steal anything that fits the bill. Bring the items back to me and I'll make sure all the Imperial Sentinels know of your deeds.
checkText
I'm sure you already know how powerful the Astral is. Their reagents are probably vessels for channeling a tiny fraction of the Astral's power.
finishText
Thank you so much. I'll inform the Sentinels of your help.
goal
Use the Battered Artillery to shoot the Astral demon and return to Sarbaz Rashepses.
startText

Oh, my poor ship!
We were sent to attack the giant Astral demon off the coast of the Tainted Valley, but now it's nothing but wreckage. I don't think the engineers could ever fix her up even if we could get her away from all the demons that have swarmed the decks. I must have revenge on the monster that caused all this!
Listen, I'm pretty sure that some of the ship's cannons are still working. Travel to the coast and board what's left of the vessel, then fire a shot at that damned Astral demon!
Me and the rest of the crew would be grateful for your efforts.
checkText
No cannons should be wasted! That's the motto of a true Astral sailor.
finishText
Excellent! Hopefully that demon is in a lot of pain right now. You know, I bet that cannon has a few more shots left in it. Return to me tomorrow and perhaps you can take another shot at the enemy.
goal
Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages or Shadowy Demon Mages for Svarog Linev.
startText

I can already see that you're trustworthy! Your dedication to slaying demons is the only proof I need! That's how it was in the Great Astral Campaign and that's how it remains today.
Listen, the other Defenders respect me. If you want to improve your reputation among the League Defenders, I can put in a word for you.
Especially if you help us out.
Kill six Malevolent Demon Mages or Shadowy Demon Mages. Every League Defender will know your name!
checkText
I lost many, many friends in the last Campaign.And it's like it didn't even matter! It's just endless blood and death, like we never won. Ugh!
finishText

It's people like you that helped us secure our victory over the demons 40 years ago.
You have my sincere thanks. That's what League Defenders say, too.
goal
Collect 6 Astral Crystals for Dmitry Svetlov by hunting Fiendish Predators and Foul Demon Scouts.
startText

Forgive us, great Tensess, for what we done.
We used the power of the demons... but it was for a good purpose! For the triumph of the Light!
Lately, I have been finding it increasingly difficult to find volunteers willing to provide us with dark Astral crystals. What are dark Astral Crystals? They're these strange and terrible little crystals that you can get from the demons. We need them to keep this portal private and maintained.
It's not that we can't get anyone to fight the demons... the League Defenders aren't afraid, it's just that no one wants to touch the crystals. You pick it up and feel the pure evil... right in your hand.
Maybe you can help us? You can find them on the predators just outside the camp. Help me, and I'll tell Rogneda all about your dedication.
checkText
Rumor has it that the Astral is a primordial matter that's filled with incredible energy. I don't know... To me, that's just an ocean of evil and darkness!
finishText
Thank you. Now we can keep this portal up and running. And, as promised, I will tell Rogneda about all you've done.
goal
Fire the canon from the crashed Imperial ship at the Octulhu and report back to the Whirligig Family.
startText

We caught us a Xadaganian scout the other day and, boy, did he put on a great performance! He kept insisting that we let him go because his precious Empire needs him!
He claims that there's an Octulhu loitering just off the shore near the Imperial camp. And he says that it's his duty to keep a constant attack on the demon. Can you believe that?! He says he just sits there all day firing on a stationary target!
But we know better. If he's supposed to fire at a demon all day then what was he doing sneaking around over here? Does he think that we were born yesterday?! Go see if he's telling the truth. And if there really is an Octulhu over there, fire the canon one time for us!
checkText
Oh, those silly Imperial soldier! What do they think they're doing over there?
finishText

Well done!
Now we just need to figure out what do we say to the guys from the Empire after we'd wiped their nose...
goal
Kill 6 League Veterans or Defenders in the League Camp. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

What do you think about a daring and dangerous mission whose purpose is to show the League who's the master of this cursed land? Sounds good? I knew you'd say that!
Not long ago the League organized a raiding party and attacked our camp. We fended off their soldiers, but that's not enough. We must pay them back for their incursion. Revenge will be swift and merciless!
Go to the League settlement and break past their barricades. Kill as many battlemages and defenders as you can find. It won't be an easy task, so you should probably organize some friends to go with you. Return to me when you're victorious!
checkText
There's no time to waste. The League must be dealt with today!
finishText
Nice work. Now the League knows that hiding inside their camp won't save them. Come back to me tomorrow and I'll give you another mission to destroy the bastards.
goal
Kill 3 Elven players, 3 Gibberling players, and 3 Kanian players and return to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

In the middle of our battles with the cultists and the demons we must not forget the second part of our mission. I'm talking about the League.
I know that we have the same reason for coming to this forsaken allod, but at the same time we cannot forget the League's past discretions. They're slaughtering our comrades in the Holy Land! Additionally, Yasker made it clear that we need to be the ones to defeat the demons, not them.
The same laws of war are still in place. Every Kanian, Gibberling, and Elf that you see is the enemy. Send them to Purgatory until they decide to leave this land!
checkText
This land originally belonged to the Xadaganians, you know. It's yet another reason the League should not be here!
finishText
Thank you for your service! If you want to continue fighting the League, return to me tomorrow and I'll give you another mission.
goal
Kill 6 Imperial Sentinels or Spellcasters in the Imperial Camp. Report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

Yesterday was a bad day... Very bad! I never would have expected to see an Imperial Sentinel brandishing an ax and shouting obscenities right here in this very camp!
We cannot afford to have the Empire attacking us alongside the demons! If they're not going to fight fairly, why should we?! I want you to gather an army and attack the Imperial Camp! Show them what a true League champion is made of!
checkText
It's time for the Empire to understand the consequences of messing with the League!
finishText
Hopefully the Imperials learned their lesson. And if not... Well then, we'll just have to remind them.
goal
Kill 3 Orcish Players, 3 Xadaganian Players, and 3 Arisen Players and report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

Even though Aidenus gave us clear orders to fight the demons, we must not forgot about the Empire!
And it looks like Yasker gave his troops the exact the same order. How else do we explain the constant barrage from the Imperial forces? It's even putting a hold on their own fight with the demons!
We're fighting a war with many fronts. We have many enemies, and to survive we must not give any of them even an inch! And so, we must inflict the first blow! Is that clear?
checkText
Don't let compassion prevail! Think of those who fell in the fight against the Empire in the Holy Land!
finishText
Good job. I think I'll have to give the same order again tomorrow... It will take some time before the Empire realizes how stupid it is to oppose the League!
goal
Kill 6 Wily Demon Scouts near the League Camp and report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

We really stirred up a hornet's nest when we landed. The cultists didn't expect us to capture the portal, and now they're fighting like mad to get it back!
All the while, demons are just pouring in from the Astral. The coast is filled with the creatures. I've already sent a request for additional support, but we need to weather the storm until they get here.
Why don't you get out there and help? Take a walk along the coast and kill twelve demon scouts! After that we
checkText
The demons are along the coast and in the Astral! Will there ever be an end to this madness?
finishText

We've repelled this attack, but there will be more... We are too few to wage open warfare!
The Imperial landing party is in the exact situation as us. All we can do is hope to receive reinforcements before the Empire does...
goal
Collect 6 measures of Fiery Essence on the Blackened Shore, then report back to Dmitry Svetlov.
startText

May the Light shine upon your path!
The other day a swarm of demons tried to launch an offensive through the portal. We caught it in time and repelled the attack. Since then we've kept Tensess's holy flame burning in our braziers.
It's the flame and our prayers that keep the demons at bay. But we're going to need some fiery essence in order to keep the fire going. You can get it from the fire elementals that roam the eastern part of Blackened Shore.
Collect six measures of fiery essence for me and the boys. It is vital to our survival!
checkText
We can't allow those vile beasts to break through the portal and into our camp! Where's the fire essence? It needs to be added to the flame!
finishText

Let the flame burn ever brighter! The fire of Holy Tensess is the surest way of battling the demons, especially with our prayers magnifying its effect multifold. And so we keep up our prayers day and night. I thank you for your help. May the power of Tensess be with you!
goal
Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Mystics, then report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

I have received orders from Aidenus to assume the offensive and secure a foothold on the Blackened Shore. He's worried that the Empire might swing the momentum there over to their side. Can you believe that?! That's our ship!
As soon as we started in to the Shore, the enemy swooped in to attack the berth! They were trying to toss us into the Astral! Help our fighters by killing some of those cultists and demons!
checkText
I don't have enough soldiers or mages to secure a position on the Blackened Shore. I can't leave our camp undefended, now can I?
finishText

I thank you for a job well done! Maybe now we'll be able to secure the Shore and carry out Aidenus' orders. You know, we've been through worse. When we first landed here, it was without any preliminary scouting and we quickly found ourselves lost in the mountains and fighting off hundreds of rabid kobolds. Then, we ended up ramming right into an Orc outpost. That was quite an excursion, believe you me! But we managed then and we'll manage now. We're called troopers for a reason!
goal
Kill Minikar the Sadistic and Lada Grusova and report back to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

The advantage that the demons and cultists have isn't only in numbers. They're also well organized and that is the main reason why we haven't been able to force them deeper into Yazes Shard.
What we need to is liquidate their commanders! It'll be crucial to our overall success. And since you have extensive experience in settling matters such as this, you've been selected to handle it!
The demon commander is called Minikar the Sadistic and our scouts report that he's somewhere in the Tainted Valley. And the cultists are headed by Archmage Lada Grusova, who has been spotted at the Wild Cape, not far from the Imperial camp.
Remember, as long as they're alive we cannot resume our offensive!
checkText
It's difficult to hold the line when your opponent has commanders like that. The demon and that Grusova hag must be destroyed!
finishText
And now we'll watch the panic set in among the enemy ranks! They've gotten used to relying on their commanders, so this will be a severe blow to their morale.
goal
Place the 2 Signal Cups into the ancient June ruins on either side of the League Settlement and report back to the Whirligig Family.
startText

Hooray!
Good news! Rogneda Boykova has reported that we will reinforcements will be arriving soon! Three powerful Astral ships are rushing on their way here!
And on their decks are tough veterans, new weapons and ammunition, and of course, crates and crates of sweets! We need to prepare! We must give the ships a signal! We need a signal that screams "We are here! Here!"
So, let's see what we have around here to work with. These signal cups should do it! Go put these in the ruins to the east and west of here. That'll show them where we are!
checkText
Picking the right landing spot is crucial to mission success! Have the beacons been set?
finishText

Wonderful! Now we just wait for their arrival.
We were initially banking on capturing Yazes Shard in one fell swoop... But the enemies were too many, so we had to ask for help.
goal
Protect Augusta de Ardeur from demon attacks while she performs the ritual.
startText

Come here, I need your help! The chapels on Yazes Shard are too far from the battlefield! Resurrected soldiers are going to waste precious time and energy running back to rejoining their troops on the front lines.
I want to build a new chapel here in enemy territory. I've already got my eye on this spot, but the area needs to be cleared of demons before I can begin. Please help me! I cannot do this by myself. I need someone to protect me while I'm performing the ritual.
checkText
Please kill those demons! They're not letting me perform the ritual!
finishText

Thanks and don't worry too much about me - I'll be able finish the chapel by myself. The House de Ardeur is renowned for its architects, you know. This will be my third field chapel, actually!
When the construction is complete, the League and Imperial soldiers will be resurrected here, right by the battlefield, and be able to lay into those blasted demons with renewed strength and vigor!
goal
Bring 3 Demon Horns and 3 amulets of Darksoul Ravagers to Svarog Linev.
startText

I remember a time when the League and the Empire fought together against the demons. Now look at us, we can't even put aside our differences long enough to save our world. Yes, I took part in the Great Astral Campaign! I look good for my age, don't I? Hah!
Rumor has it that you've been busy performing all kinds of heroic feats. I'd like to see you in action myself so I'll know if you can be counted on. Go and kill something on the Blackened Shore! Demons, cultists, whatever! Just remember to bring me back some sort of proof.
checkText
I have lost a lot of friends over the years. Some have been killed by demons, others by Imperial soldiers. I thought that most of the bloodshed was over after the Great Astral Campaign...
finishText

I went over to the Wild Gorge the other day. I had a craving to gut a demon or two to show those recruits how it's done. I never saw any demons... but I did run into an old friend of mine, an Imperial soldier!
Back in our, day we fought against the demons side by side. We recognized each other right away, took a few minutes to catch up, and then went our separate ways... What? No, I'm not crying, I just got some sand in my eye! I forgot how to cry ages ago. Give me those amulets and horns!
Good job, by the way. This wasn't an easy task. We could've used you in the Great Astral Campaign.
goal
Kill 6 Wily Demon Scouts on the Wild Cape shore. Report back to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

So, your first task.
The demons keep trying to drive us off the Wild Cape and reclaim the demonic portal in our camp. Demon scouts constantly land along the shore and attack anyone that ventures outside. I have sent a request to Yasker for more troops. I'm sure he'll deliver. He seems to understand the importance of our operation. But it might be a while... So we'll have to fend for ourselves for the time being.
Well, I'm sure you get the picture. We need to kill Wily Demon Scouts. Go out and kill six of them.
checkText
How many demons did you kill? We must drive their vile breed away from our camp!
finishText

Thank you for killing those monsters! Unfortunately, they're but a small portion of the enormous army of demons and cultists here on Yazes Shard. The bulk of their forces lie beyond the Demonic Gates to the north, but the area is inaccessible to even our scouts.
The initial plan was to clear out the coast in one fell swoop, crush their defenses and pursue the enemy beyond the Gates. So far we've barely been able to secure a foothold here at the Wild Cape. Perhaps we can make some progress now.
goal
Collect 6 Slimy Eyes and bring them to Yaver Khaba.
startText

There are things that should be taken into account. Mainly demons.
The Astral isn't the only place the demons are launching their attacks from. Not long ago they poured out of this portal right here and caught us by surprise. Ever since then our mages have been keeping the portal closed with their magic.
It's terribly draining, so they've been using magical reagents for their spells. One of those reagents is the eyes of the Damned Eye demons. These monsters inhabit the shore just to the west of here.
Bring me six eyes so we can keep that horrible portal sealed.
checkText
With the right reagents a seasoned mage can keep a whole army of demons from using the portal. Now where are those eyes?
finishText

Good, these are just what we needed. You see, these eyes are part of an ancient recipe. They are dried, crushed, and mixed into a powder that we burn during the recital of our spells.
Even so, this job requires the caster to maintain the utmost concentration. Just imagine the stress! Go on, try and recite a spell for even an hour - you couldn't stand the headache! But we're still here, reciting them day and night.
goal
Kill 6 Abyssal Demon Mages or Darksoul Ravagers and return to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

No matter how bad things are we must complete our mission. Yasker expects us to act decisively. We were ordered to immediately crush the vermin in their own territory, and so we shall!
The League is so much luckier. Their camp is on a small allod and in a good position to fend off attacks. Our camp, on the other hand, is in plain sight and thus much harder to defend. Demons and cultists attack us day and night.
Well, the bastards won't stop until they recapture their portal or we slaughter every last one of them. I prefer the latter option. Victory is still far off, but we can at least ensure the safety of our camp by thinning the enemy's numbers. Kill ten demons and ten cultists and return to me.
checkText
Are they dead? Their numbers need to be lessened immediately, lest they gather up a considerable force on the shore and hurl us into the Astral!
finishText

Excellent! My scouts report that the demons have retreated from our camp. Even better, they've refocused their attacks on the League settlement. I do hope the League survives, though. We're all in one boat here. If the League soldiers are destroyed, the demons will come right back to us.
At the same time, it is us and only us who shall prevail over them, while the League must settle for an honorable second place.
goal
Kill Lada Grusova and Minikar the Sadistic and return to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

The demons and cultists boast highly disciplined armies. They advance in an organized manner, fight as a group, and retreat without so much as a semblance of panic. They also send out recon parties before every battle. All of those are aspects of sound leadership.
Fortunately, my scouts have found out who those leaders are - the demons obey Minikar the Sadistic, stationed over at the Blackened Shore not far from the League camp. The cultists are headed by Lada Grusova who was recently sighted here at the Wild Cape.
I am ordering you to kill them both, and the sooner the better! Now get going!
checkText
Did you find Minikar and that Lada Grusova lady? I trust that they're no longer with us?
finishText
Good job! Now's the time to attack when the enemy's disoriented and confused. We need to organize an operation immediately.
goal
Set the Bright Signal Beacons on the Dark Altars and return to Sarbaz Rashepses.
startText

I'm so tired of waiting! I'm going to rust over soon if I don't get something to do. You see, I was the captain of a great Astral ship a few days ago. Unfortunately, it was destroyed by a rather large demon just to the north of here.
Ever since then I've been left with nothing to do. I'm just waiting on the shore for more ships to arrive so I can give them a hand with their operations. I hope they hurry up. I want to fire some cannons!
In the mean time, I suppose I should start preparing for the ships' arrival. It would make the cannoneers' jobs a lot easier if some signal beacons were planted near their main targets.
Here, take these two beacons and put them on the cultists' dark altars. The bastards tend to group up around there and conduct various demonic rituals. One shot could probably take out more than a dozen of them!
checkText
Are the beacons set? We need to make sure every shot counts!
finishText
Excellent work! I can't wait to charge up the cannons and get this party started!
goal
Search the cultists for something that could explain the cultists' fascination with the Astral fangs.
startText

The Empire invited me here as a consultant. The Demon Hunters know more about demons and cultists than anyone else. But if I knew this place was in such turmoil, I might have thought twice before diving into this mess alone.
Since I've gotten here I've done a good bit of recon work. Turns out those cracked cultists have a past time of sorts that involves sitting around the Astral fangs. They stay there forever without moving a muscle as if they're spellbound!
This needs some further investigating. I caught a few cultists, but I couldn't get anything useful out of 'em. That means it's time for brute force. Hunt the cultists and see if they have anything that holds the key to this riddle!
checkText
Maybe they worship those Fangs? I have no idea!
finishText

This black stone is brimming with dark energy.
I'd reckon this thing is stronger than a mana elixir. I bet the cultists charge these stones with magical energy as they meditate at the Astral fangs. Then they can use these stones later to replenish their energy in combat.
Hm... Well, thanks for this information. Now there's one less riddle to solve, but we're still far from understanding those strange cultists.
goal
Bring 3 Cultist Amulets and 3 Demon Horns to Evgeny Byvalin.
startText

I feel like true heroes have gone extinct! Back in my day the world was full of them. What's that you say? I'm hard of hearing after the recent concussion. A demon threw me to the ground so hard, I thought it was the end of me. But nope, I'm still here!
What was I talking about? Oh yes, heroes! The soldiers in the Great Astral Campaign were made of tough stuff. I myself am a veteran. Forty years ago I traveled with Nezeb and Skrakan to the June Gates. Few of us made it... We thought it was over! And demons were finally gone! But when we arrived at this allod, those hopes were shattered. Yeah...
Well, what about you? Are you ready for war? Ready to die for the freedom of the world? Or are you simply here to collect a few medals while you let others do the work? Well, I'm going to test your resolve right here and now!
Bring me three amulets from the cultists and three horns from those demons. Of course they won't part with them easily! You'll have to do some convincing! Exactly!
Then I'll know if I can count on you to get stuff done out here.
checkText

I remember getting shipwrecked around here during the Great Astral Campaign. A storm swept our ship away from the rest of the squadron and hurled it at the cliffs.
Ah, this land was very different in those days. Perhaps I'll tell you more of that story when you finish my task.
finishText

Ah, the horns and the amulets. Let me put them down right here. Hm, well I guess I can rely on you. Good to know that not all the new soldiers are wimps!
Oh yes, let me finish my story. Well, our ship was not the only one to crash against the cliffs. In fact, a Kanian vessel had also been shipwrecked. There on the shore contemplating the war I met one of the League soldiers. His name was Svarog, and we talked at length about the problems of the world.
Remember that one of the most important things in life is to know your goals. Without direction, you are doomed to fail. That is why we must identify the real threat to Sarnaut and put all our energy into stopping it!
goal
Plant 1 Shadowy Detector near the new Demon Portal and 1 Shadowy Detector near the Demonic Gate and return to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

My scouts have just come back from the Demonic Gate to the north and do you know what they discovered? Another demonic portal!
If they use at and are able to overtake our camp, they'll be able to take this portal here right to the League! Can you imagine it? Demons roaming all over Novograd... That's why it's important for us to know what's happening.
I need you to take these two probes and place them out by the portal and the Gates. These devices were a gift from the Demon Hunters, not it's time we took them out for a test run!
checkText

The Demon Hunters refuse to sell the League the manufacture patent for detectors. They're using their neutral status as an excuse, but I know they just want a monopoly on the market! Have the detectors been set?
finishText

Conducting reconnaissance on Yazes Shard is difficult and dangerous work. You've got cultists around every corner and the demons looking down from above! And that's why I'm so glad that you managed to set those detectors.
Hmm... This is strange. The detectors are telling us that demons and cultists are constantly leaving the Gates and then vanishing in the portal. Which begs the question - where are those bastards going?!
goal
Investigate the Dark Idol in the Baneful Valley.
startText

May Tensess help us!
It's getting harder and harder to hold off the demons that are trying to come in through the portal.
Our enemy has switched to magic attacks and we're weakening by the hour! North west of here lies the Baneful Valley. Our scouts have reported seeing cultists conducting bizarre rituals by some strange statue. And the first of the magic attacks took place around the time that they were spotted.
I think it's time that we really investigated it. Go to the idol and check it out, if someone gets in your way, kill them in the name of Tensess!
finishText

I've heard enough prayers and psalms! I need the blood of the lost! Only blood can help me best Tensess' power!
Bring me the blood of the lost! Feed me! Feed me!
goal
Gather 6 portions of the Blood of the Lost and report to Dmitry Svetlov.
startText

That bloodthirsty idol wants "blood of the lost." But what is "the lost?" The fallen soldier of the League and Empire?
The blood will help him to best the magic of Tensess and if this happens, the paladins will falter and the demons will pour in through the portal and into our camp. The cultists have already collected this "blood of the lost" and will soon hand it over to the idol. There's only way to stop them - take the blood away!
checkText
Uh... The situation has improved here... I wonder what caused this?
finishText

Too bad we can't just destroy the statue... But you've managed to disrupt some sort of terrible cultist ritual and in so doing, rendered the idol harmless for the time being. What I'd really like to know is what sort of deity that thing is supposed to represent. After all, its power was great enough to match that of Tensess himself! Well, whatever it is, you've given us some much needed respite, so let's take advantage of it.
goal
Scout out the situation along the western shore and report back to the Whirligig Family at the League Settlement.
startText

We just got back from the Baneful Valley and now Rogneda wants us to go again! But this time, she wants us to take a ship along the shore.
We're really limited on resources and can't afford to lose anything! And we're already got a real bad feeling about this... So we want you to scout the area out first. Go along the coastline and explore the area. Learn as much as you can, but be sure to watch out for the demons. They love to hang out on the shore.
checkText
How far did you get? Do you think it's safe for our boat?
finishText
What did you say? Octulhu?! ...OCTULHU?! There's no way we're taking our dinky little boat up against an octulhu! Maybe if we had Aidenus' fleet... But that's still no guarantee!
goal
Obtain 4 Orders from the Darksoul messengers and return to Rogneda Boykova.
startText

You don't know how hard it is to capture a cultist alive! They always insist on fighting to the death... Whether it be by own hand or their own!
But what we can try to do is intercept the orders that they receive from their brass. I want you to go kill the couriers in Baneful Valley and the Tainted Valley. Loot their corpses and bring the orders to me. Four orders should hold enough information for us to learn what our enemy's intentions are. Let's get to work!
checkText
We've spent so much time searching and we still don't have a single prisoner! We've tried everything - even distributing leaflets that offered cultists voluntary surrender! Nothing works!
finishText

Excellent! What? No! These can't be right! These are orders that have been signed by Gorluxor! It can't be! We killed him... Three times to be exact!
But what if those Gorluxor's that we killed were just clones? What if there's a hundred other Gorluxor's just waiting to be sent out? Oh, this isn't good. This isn't good at all! We had better tell Aidenus immediately!
goal
Look for Maxim Lukov by the Demonic Gate.
startText

Listen, I sent a scout out to the Demonic Gate earlier, but he has yet to return. There are a lot of bad rumors going around about that place, but we've always refused to believe them.
I already know that you have no fear of the demons and cultists. Hell, you decommission them by the dozens! Just like I used to, back in my day... But I digress. Your mission is to make for the Gates and look for our scout. He goes by Maxim Lukov. You can do it, I know you can!
finishText
I've come here to tell you that our troops have captured your scout. The United Array must not sit on its hands. It's an outrage that we must keep hiding like some sort of fugitive!
goal
Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages, then report to Svarog Linev and give him Dina Sondova's message.
startText

It's a real pity that our leaders refuse to realize that the League and the Empire need to join forces in the fight against the demons and their minions. Just look at those demon bastards and their cultist buddies!
They've already got a city here on Yazes Shard, and it won't be long before they branch out to obliterate all living creatures throughout what's left of our world. I killed a demon scout myself just the other day, now it's your turn. Kill a dozen or so demons at the Demonic Gate and report back to the League camp.
checkText
Did you find Lukov? Where is he? Tell me he's not dead!
finishText

So, Maxim was captured by Imperial troops. While that's not exactly good news, our friends from the United Array will not stand by and allow him to be executed.
What's the United Array, you ask? Well, I'll tell you!
When it became clear that the remaining allods were once more threatened by a demon invasion, veterans from both the League and the Empire decided to join forces. It's mad that our nations continue their petty fighting when our world is about to be swarmed by the demon spawn! And many old-school warriors, myself included, couldn't sit back and watch the madness continue.
This is how the United Array was born!
goal
Use the Mystical Artifact to read the minds of 5 Darksoul Supplicators and return to Gerasim Gromov.
startText

I can't stop thinking about those cultists! What could be driving them to do all those terrible deeds?! Could the demons have clouded their minds with magic? Or maybe they're seeking to gain something from their service? Or maybe we're dealing with something else entirely... Something unlike anything we've ever encountered.
My question isn't just some idle curiosity. I firmly believe that if we know what the enemy's intentions are, it'll help us to emerge victorious in this war! I'm going to give you this artifact that's imbued with a psionicist's power. I want you to sneak up to some cultists and read their minds.
Then when you come back, we'll be able to analyze their thoughts!
checkText

We thought that these cultists just worshipped the demons. My colleague, Arnold de Grandeur, even penned a three-volume monograph on the subject that went on to win an Aidenus Prize last year. It was only recently that we've started to have our doubts...
finishText

Even a superficial analysis of cultist thoughts is sufficient enough to disprove Arnold de Grandeur's theory. The cultists do not worship the demons themselves, what they worship is the power behind them!
goal
Travel north along the eastern shore and report your sightings to Sarbaz Rashepses.
startText

Verkhovin ordered the eastern coast of this allod to be scouted by Astral ship. As you know, that mission already failed. He asked me if I could complete the mission on foot because I was part of the ship's crew, but there's no way I'd get past those cultists!
I just work the cannons you know. I'm not a scout! But you... you look pretty capable. Maybe you could take this mission on yourself? I'm sure you'd succeed. And this mission needs to be a success. Verkhovin said it was very important. It better be important if my ship was sacrificed for it!
So what do you say? Help me out? Just go north along the coast as far as you can go and tell me what you see.
checkText
How did the recon mission go? Did you get all the way up the coast? What's happening on the shores and in the Astral?
finishText

Wow! Now I understand why Verkhovin wanted that shore scouted so badly. The cultists' defenses are much weaker up there. Now that we know this, we can plan an attack on the demon city from behind. They'll get blasted to pieces! The only problem is that one demon that destroyed my ship...
goal
Investigate the Astral whirlpool to the west of the Tainted Valley.
startText

Even with the use of magical reagents, we're finding it increasingly difficult to keep the portal closed. The demons keep attempting to break through our spells, and the pressure is only increasing.
On top of that, all of the mages were recently affected by some strong dark energy. Our spells have suddenly begun to weaken, and we need more and more reagents for our magic to work.
This phenomenon is probably related to the influence of the Astral. This has been observed to some extent by scientists at the ZIT when working on a certain secret project.
A large Astral whirlpool has recently appeared off the northeast coast. Head over there and examine it immediately. If the Astral is causing these effects, they should be the strongest over there.
finishText

Aaaah! Save us, help us!
We were heading to the Demonic Gates when these horrible cultists captured us.
Then they put us in this cage! They're throwing their prisoners into the Astral whirlpool, chanting some demonic words and appealing to the "power of the Astral". You have to help us!
goal
Get the keys from the cultists and free 3 captives. Return to Yaver Khaba.
startText

Listen, we must free all the prisoners! We don't know why their throwing us in the Astral, but it can't continue! Not only for our sake, but for the sake of everyone. We're pretty sure that whatever ritual their conducting will bring suffering to their enemies.
Kill the cultists, take their keys, and open all the cages. The Astral will not get our souls! After you rescue everyone, return to your camp and tell your leaders what happened. We've got a common enemy here on Yazes Shard, and we must work together if we want to survive!
checkText
It seems that we're regaining some of our power. That means whatever you did worked!
finishText

Hm... It seems that whatever spell those cultists were casting was strengthened by throwing sacrifices into the Astral whirlpool. Perhaps it was using their souls for energy? Unfortunately we don't have the time to investigate this phenomenon right now, but it's good that we got our powers back. Thank you!
goal
Plant 1 Shadowy Detector near the new Demon Portal and 1 Shadowy Detector near the Demonic Gate and return to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

I'm about to entrust you with another important mission. I assume you're already acquainted with Boom the Merciless? He's a Demon Hunter - one of the best, they say. A few days ago I would have objected to interference by an outside faction, but now I see how valuable his advice is.
He recently suggested a new operation. You see, our scouts have reported that outside the Demonic Gates is another demonic portal. Through it the demons will be able to keep sending reinforcements until they overwhelm our camp.
At the moment we don't have enough forces to assault the demons near the portal, but we can monitor it. Take these detectors that Boom gave me. He says they'll monitor and all demonic activity so we won't get any surprises. Plant one near the Demonic Gates and one near the portal itself.
checkText
Those detectors should come in handy. Hmm... I wonder if they could be reconfigured to detect League activity. That would make our mission in the Holy Land much easier.
finishText

The detectors are already working! We just discovered that most of the demons are coming out of the portal, through the demonic gates, and into the ruined city that lies beyond. Now we won't lost any more scouts in that region - this device can do the job instead.
goal
Obtain all 4 of the cultists' secret messages and return to Adam Verkhovin.
startText

The enemy is about to strike, but we have no idea when or where! Many times now we've tried to capture and interrogate a cultist, but those fanatical loonies fight to the death. If they see that captivity is imminent, they just kill themselves!
But there's another way to learn the enemy's plans - by intercepting the orders the cultists receive from their leaders.
Our scouts have spotted two cultists near the Baneful Valley and two near the Tainted Valley carrying what appear to be orders. Kill them and bring anything of interest to me. I don't have to tell you how crucial this mission is so get to work!
checkText
We can't do anything until we gather accurate intelligence on the enemy! Where are the cultists' secret messages?
finishText

This is worse than we expected... these orders are signed by Gorluxor! It seems that their best troops have been redeployed to the portal dimension. Now they're waiting for League paladins and Imperial mages to lose control over the portals in their respective camps.
Once that happens they plan to flood into our bases. Then the remaining forces will attack from the front and we'll find ourselves caught between two fronts! This is an insidious plan, and it will be the end of us if we allow them to succeed!
goal
Look for Tamara Byvalina near the Demonic Gates.
startText

Alright, it's time to send you on a real mission. My daughter Tamara came to Yazes Shard with me. She's an excellent saboteur, and she was sent to explore some strange activity near the Demonic Gates. Unfortunately she never came back.
I know in my heart that Tamara is still alive. While the odds are not in favor of her survival, I beg you to investigate her disappearance. Go to the Demonic Gates and see what you can find.
And if you happen to meet some soldiers of the League please stay your weapons. Here in this land they are not our greatest enemies. We might even have to cooperate with them if things continue to get worse.
finishText

Ah, you've come looking for Tamara?
Well, we have some good news for you. She's being held in our camp under the pretense of being a prisoner. However, in reality she's there to communicate with Svarog, so tell Byvalin not to worry too much.
One more thing. Svarog believes that the time has come for the United Array to reveal itself.
Enough of this hiding! We must fight this battle together!
goal
Kill 6 Malevolent Demon Mages and relay the Ears Family's message to Evgeny Byvalin.
startText

We'll show them! The demons will be sorry! Just imagine... The League and the Empire fighting together! Shoulder to shoulder! Just as it was forty years ago! Yes!
Imagine the things we could accomplish! Just look how many demons there are around here. Every day they continue to pour out from the ruined city. Right now we can barely hold our ground, much less defeat them.
But we'll do our best! If you care about the future of Sarnaut, join us and help us get rid of those demons. If you agree, then I suggest you start by killing six demons in the Baneful Valley. We'll go to the Tainted Valley and do the same!
When you see Eldar, tell him it's time! It's time!
checkText
Well, did you find my daughter? She wasn't captured by the cultists, was she?
finishText

She's in the hands of the League, eh? Well, she'll be okay as long as Svarog's around. This is truly for the best if it means helping the United Array.
As I'm sure the Ears Family already told you, the United Array is an organization created by members of both the League and the Empire to fight the demons. It was formed by veterans of the Great Astral Campaign when it became clear that the demonic threat had not been eliminated.
"United we stand, divided we fall!" That's our motto. If we don't unite, the demons will destroy both the League and the Empire. It's a pity that most of our leaders are too caught up in politics to understand. That's why our organization is a secret for now.
goal
Read the minds of 5 cultists using the Mystical Artifact and return to Flamefist the Righteous.
startText

I was sent here to provide some brains to this operation, not just brawn. We must understand these cultists, and to do that you must be a thinker, not a punisher!
I heard from Verkhovin that you're a pretty resourceful person, so I was wondering if you could help the Sentinels. We need to figure out why these nuts are willing to give their lives to serve the demons. Did the demons inflict their brains with some disease? Or are they promising them a reward?
Take this device. It was invented by the City Council and it can be used to read the mind of its target. But be warned - you are only authorized to use it on the cultists, no one else! Come back to me after you've read the minds of five cultists.
checkText
Make sure you're very careful with the artifact. I don't feel like explaining why something so valuable was damaged.
finishText

Astral take my soul! You don't have to be a genius to figure out that it's not the demons these cultists are worshipping! The demons are merely a weapon to them, one that is guided by some unknown force, the name of which the cultists don't dare speak aloud!
Maybe they don't even know that name. Either way, we were dead wrong about these fellas and their intentions! Thanks for your help, the brass back at the capital will be quite shocked to learn this.
goal
Relay Svarog Linev's message to Rogneda Boykova, the League Campaign Leader.
startText

It has been decided! The United Array must now act openly and directly!
We were forced to act in secrecy so as to not be accused of treason. But now that the demons are planning an attack, it's time to put all of our cards on the table. Tell Rogneda Boykova that the only way we can prevail is if we pool our forces and resources together with the Empire!
finishText

Svarog Linev is asking me to make a rather difficult decision. One where I could actually be accused of treason! On the other hand, the demons are about to launch an offensive...
Their troops are waiting in the portal dimensions and our paladins are once more being besieged with magical attacks. If we don't act now, we'll all be destroyed before long. It seems as if we cannot defeat the demonic threat individually... Only together.
